source: Originale emojiudtryk genereret med det godkendte 3D-portræt som identitetsreference.
preparation: Fem transparente ark med seks reaktioner hver. Hver reaktion er beskåret i sin egen celle og centreret med ensartet transparent margen i en RGBA PNG på 1254 × 1254 px. Oprindelige farver og halvgennemsigtige kanter er bevaret.

sheets.prompt:
Create a game-ready transparent six-cell reaction atlas, 1536x1024 LANDSCAPE with EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows. The provided image is the approved identity reference for the one adult female Crested Tit character present once in each cell. Match her tall swept black-and-cream speckled feather crest, tiny pointed beak, charcoal cheek stripe and throat bib, creamy belly, taupe wings, dark warm eye and exact cobalt blue scarf with ONE knot and TWO short ends. Painterly Danish/Finnish storybook warmth, softly modeled realistic feather layers, gentle stylized stop-motion/matte textile maquette depth, warm rich readable materials. Each reaction is an optically centered compact animated bird BUST sticker, crop body smoothly at its natural rounded base, no rectangular crop. One bird only in every cell. Focus on readable head and face, emotions and one large clear symbol or prop placed comfortably alongside the bird, using depth sparingly at emoji size. Give each cell strict generous transparent gutters on every side, use no more than 73% of its own 512x512 invisible square. No cross-cell elements, no touching, no backgrounds, no plinths, no colored halos, no fading shadows, no squares, no cutting off crest, no borders, no grid lines, no labels, no numbering, no watermarks, no legibility-dependent text. Full true transparent alpha around each silhouette and the whole atlas. No fingers/hands, anatomically correct folded or naturally raised bird wings, exactly one head, scarf one knot and two tails. There must be EXACTLY SIX reactions, in the precise row-major order dictated below.
Top-left. Quietly proud uplifted head beside a single round blue seal with a clear gold four-point star, her first saved milestone.
Top-middle. Thoughtful clear open eye beside one small tan note with three simple dark line marks and an obvious green check stamp.
Top-right. Eager upward gaze at an unambiguous miniature forked tan Y-shaped twig with one small cobalt tip marker.
Bottom-left. Concerned expression beside two visibly crossing burnt-orange and blue strips with a small red warning diamond at their intersection.
Bottom-middle. Relief alongside two differently colored wooden strips that fit together, with a large green check.
Bottom-right. Celebratory beak slightly open beside one ochre hanging gift tag with a teal bow, two tiny gold glints. No numerals.
